_meta.description: Gap fill from ISO Indonesia Vol. 53 (2021), PT Pharma Tekno Solusi / IAI. Per-drug dosing text parsed mechanically from the 'Ds:' field of product monographs (pdftotext), cited by PDF page and brand. These are general per-drug doses, NOT disease-specific first-line regimens. Matching basis is stated per row. NOT clinician reviewed.
_meta.note: Keyword matching is noisy; clearly unrelated matches were removed by hand (fracture, acute kidney injury, scrofuloderma, parts of cerebral palsy / corneal ulcer / vitamin deficiency).
